notes.title: Patch 1.2.1
notes.notes:
This is just a small patch with some bug fixes. :)

- Fixed a bug that prevented a hidden achievement to trigger.
- Fixed a bug related to elevators.

notes.title: Patch 1.2 is out now!
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=o4wBfCAse_g;full][/previewyoutube]
[b]We deliver what we promise... Eventually...[/b]
It took way longer than expected, but now the final levels for the game are out! Good luck! 

[b]Changelog:[/b]
- Added 16 new levels in the Factory zone!
- Added Evil Robots.
- Added 6 new achievements.
- Added music in the overworld.
- Added a bunch of bugs. 
- Added more cogs.
- Tweaked some old levels.
- Tweaked order of levels.
- Fixed a bunch of bugs.

notes.title: Regarding Cobots Patch v1.2
notes.notes:
[b]Hello everyone![/b]

We were supposed to release this patch containing the final levels for Cobots at the end of this week. However, one of our designers has gotten covid, so we can't promise that the levels will be done by then. 

Sorry about the inconvenience.

notes.title: Patch notes - v.1.1.4
notes.notes:
Hi everyone! This is a small patch with some things we've worked on this week. Note that this patch does not contain the last levels for the game. Our lead designer had to take a few days off for health reasons, and we had to postpone the release of the final levels a bit. 

[b]Changelog:[/b]
- Added two new music tracks for the factory zone.
- Added effects in the overworld when changing zones.
- Added UI audio for overworld and pause menus. 
- Tweaked audio levels and mix.
- Vacuumed the floors (removed dust particles while not on dirt).
- Fixed bug: Pausing while in overview caused the game to freeze.
- Fixed bug: "3 seconds left" warning continues to blink and sound if player restarts while it's active.
- Fixed bug: "Restart current robot" during countdown lets player move during countdown.

[b]Known issues:[/b]
- Switching zones multiple times in a row allows the player to drive into the subzone-area in the overworld, before it has finished spawning. This can cause the player to get stuck, in which case they need to restart the game. 
- Some audio doesn't pause properly.
- Using a mouse in menus can make it so that controller input doesn't work.
- And a shit-ton of other small issues. :)

notes.title: Chat With the Developers!
notes.notes:
[b]We want feedback![/b]
In order to improve the game we really want to know what you think about it! We are planning to release patches for the game the coming weeks, and this is a chance for you to affect what we focus on!
Also, make sure to leave a review on the store page, since it would help people decide if they want the game or not!

notes.title: Cobots has been released!
notes.notes:
[b]Hi everyone, and thank you for showing interest in our game![/b]

Our small team just released our first game Cobots a while ago! While there is some content missing in the current version (the last 16 levels, some achievements, music, QoL and bug fixes) we decided to launch today and add these things over the coming weeks. Launching today was a promise we made to both ourselves and others, and we want to start getting impressions from real players as soon as possible.

For now we will try to be active and around to give support, and answer any question or feedback that you might have!

We hope that you have a nice time and overcome the challenges this game has to offer!

[b]Big thanks from the Subfrost Interactive team![/b]
